label: Every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is PER_SE_5, from e8664ab8 and the sense inclusion (inference)
rule: Compose the sense inclusion with e8664ab8
meaning: Conditional derivation recording the strength order between the two bridges: if every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 link is a PER_SE_5 actual cause of being (e8664ab8) and every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is a SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 link, then every SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 link is a PER_SE_5 actual cause of being. So, given the sense bridge, the restated bridge is weaker than e8664ab8; it is the version that survives the hand-and-stick counterexample kept against e8664ab8. This is a support option for the restated bridge through a premise with a kept counterexample; the restated bridge's other support option (from 8b2561cd and the present-cause bridge) does not use e8664ab8. oldBridgeControls give, for each input, a Bool interpretation in which the other holds and the conclusion fails, and a nonvacuous one; secundaSplitLimit shows the restated bridge holding while e8664ab8 fails.
